item.title: 15×6″ Fuchs Deep Six Wheels for Porsche at No Reserve
item.description: These four 15×6″ Fuchs wheels were refinished with black-painted recessed areas and anodized lips and spokes under current ownership. Production marks include Porsche part numbers, production date codes, dimensions, and manufacturer logos. This set of “Deep Six” Fuchs wheels is now offered at no reserve in Tuxedo Park, New York.

item.title: 1928 Pontiac Series 6-28 Sport Roadster
item.description: This 1928 Pontiac is a second series 6-28 Sport Roadster that was refurbished under previous ownership before it was purchased by the selling dealer in 2025. The car is finished in gray with yellow bodyside stripes and black fenders, and power comes from a 186.5ci L-head inline-six paired with a three-speed manual transmission. item.description: This 2010 Ariel Atom 3 was acquired new by the seller and has 4k miles. item.title: 351-Powered ’32 Ford Highboy Roadster by Roy Brizio Street Rods
item.description: This '32 Ford highboy was built by Roy Brizio Street Rods in the 1990s using a fiberglass body mounted on a Brizio '32 frame, and it was raffled for charity following the build. Driven 2k miles since, it was relocated to Texas around 1997 and was acquired by its current owner in 2013. item.description: This 1996 Porsche 911 Carrera coupe was initially delivered to Deal Autohaus of Asheville, North Carolina, and it spent 13 years with its second owner before spending the next seven years registered in Hawaii. Showing 13k miles, the car was specified in Polar Silver Metallic over a Classic Grey partial leather interior, and it was ordered with the Comfort Package, a limited-slip differential, and 17" Cup II wheels.
